workflow:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: high-resolution landscape infographic for a Korean digital pathology platform report, 1536x1024 or larger. Create a polished editorial medical technology infographic on white background, crisp navy and violet typography, restrained teal highlights, subtle isometric scientific illustrations, generous whitespace. Title exact Korean: "분석 결과에서 사람의 검수까지". Subtitle exact: "MeDIAuto Studio · 작업 흐름 개념도".
Four equal, clearly numbered stages connected left to right by simple arrows. Stage 01 title "슬라이드 탐색": illustration of a glass pathology slide and a zoomed tile grid. Stage 02 title "AI 결과 검토": illustration of tissue with colored cell detection rings and a small neutral filter icon. Stage 03 title "가상염색 비교": illustration of two aligned tissue panels separated by a vertical comparison slider, neutral labels only "원본" and "생성 결과"; do not specify conversion direction. Stage 04 title "주석·패치 검수": illustration of a patch grid, human cursor and checklist.
A single horizontal foundation rail below all four stages reads exactly "동일 슬라이드 좌표 · 결과와 수정 데이터 연결". This is a navigation/workflow concept, not an automatic pipeline: small footer exact "작업 순서 예시 · 자동 재학습을 의미하지 않음".
All text must be exactly the supplied short Korean labels, fully legible. Do not add percentages, performance graphs, award badges, patent registration seals, clinical efficacy claims, vendor comparisons, actual screenshots, logos, people or extra text. Illustrations should be sophisticated scientific diagram art, not real patient tissue photographs.
tiles: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: high-resolution landscape technical infographic for a Korean digital pathology platform report. White background, navy and violet typography, teal accents, clean editorial scientific illustration, restrained soft isometric depth, generous whitespace; visually match a premium healthcare technology brochure. Title exact: "현재 화면에 필요한 타일부터". Subtitle exact: "MeDIAuto Studio · 처리 구조 개념도". Left: a large schematic slide tile grid, mostly pale gray tiles, with a violet outlined viewport containing bright purple tiles, and a cursor. Label "화면 요청". Center: two clearly distinguished paths from a cache diamond, labeled "캐시 확인". Upper teal path labeled "캐시 있음" goes to a compact image icon labeled "바로 표시". Lower violet path labeled "캐시 없음" goes to a server icon labeled "대기열·실행 수 확인", then two small lanes labeled "즉시 생성" and "우선 요청", which converge at a final tile display labeled "생성 후 표시". Along the bottom, a separated pale-gray lane with slide stack and AI processor icons labeled "백그라운드 타일링·AI", with a modest pause symbol and exact caption "뷰어 활동을 고려해 작업 양보". No return arrows from cache-hit to generation. No speed comparison, no numbers except none, no timing promises, no graphs, no claims about fairness or multi-server scale. Small footer exact "실제 성능 수치가 아닌 코드 기반 동작 설명". All Korean labels accurate and legible; diagrams conceptual, not product UI screenshots.
